meta.title: {name} — Many stores. One door.
meta.description: ShopsDoor is a platform for building and running independent online stores: products, orders, payments and markets, all behind one door.

hero.lead: ShopsDoor gives independent sellers everything to open an online store: a store builder, products and orders, secure payments and markets in several languages and currencies.

features.title: Everything a store needs, behind one door.
features.lead: Set up, sell and grow without stitching tools together. Features marked “Coming soon” are still in development.

builder.title: Store & page builder
builder.desc: Pick a theme, drop in sections and publish pages without code. Your brand colours, fonts and logo throughout.

products.title: Products, variants & inventory
products.desc: Simple or variable products, collections, stock levels and per-variant images, managed from one dashboard.

orders.title: Orders & fulfilment
orders.desc: See every order, update its status, add shipping methods and keep customers informed by email.

payments.title: Payments via Stripe
payments.desc: Card and local payment methods through Stripe. Payouts go straight to your own Stripe account.

markets.title: Markets, languages & currencies
markets.desc: Sell the same store in several countries with their own language, currency and domain.

domains.title: Custom domains
domains.desc: Start on a free ShopsDoor subdomain and connect your own domain when you are ready.

analytics.title: Analytics & insights
analytics.desc: Sales, traffic and best-sellers in one clear view.

marketing.title: Email campaigns
marketing.desc: Send newsletters and offers to your customers from inside the dashboard.

sell.title: Your own products, personalised ones, or a supplier’s.
sell.lead: Four kinds of products run on ShopsDoor today: simple items with variants, personalised gifts made to order, products shipped by verified suppliers, and bundles.

own.title: Your own products
own.desc: Simple or with variants like size and colour, with images per variant and stock levels.

custom.title: Personalised products
custom.desc: Customers add names, text and photos in the built-in designer. Print, laser engraving and 3D-print workflows included.

supplier.title: Supplier products
supplier.desc: Pick products from verified suppliers and sell them under your own brand. The supplier ships.

bundle.title: Bundles & gift sets
bundle.desc: Combine several products into one offer or gift set.

sell.categoriesLabel: Categories already selling on the platform

how.title: Open your door in three steps.
how.lead: From sign-up to the first order without a developer.

s1.title: Create your store
s1.desc: Sign up, name your store and choose a theme. You get a ShopsDoor address right away.
s1.caption: yourstore.shopsdoor.com

s2.title: Add products & connect payments
s2.desc: Add your products, set prices and shipping, and connect your Stripe account to get paid.
s2.caption: Stripe · connected

s3.title: Publish & grow
s3.desc: Share your store, connect your own domain and open new markets when you are ready.
s3.caption: yourdomain.com

pricing.title: Simple pricing, coming soon.
pricing.lead: ShopsDoor is in early access. Plans and prices will be published here before general availability.
pricing.planDesc: For independent sellers who want to be first through the door.

points.p1: Transparent monthly plans with no hidden fees
points.p2: Payment processing billed by Stripe at Stripe's standard rates
points.p3: Cancel your subscription at any time

pricing.cta: Talk to us about early access
pricing.note: Prices will be shown in SEK and EUR, excluding VAT where applicable.

contact.title: Talk to us.
contact.lead: Questions about the platform, early access or partnerships? Write to us and a real person will reply.
contact.name: Your name
contact.sent: Thanks — we will get back to you shortly.
contact.error: Something went wrong. Please email us directly.
contact.notConfigured: The contact form is not connected yet. Please email us directly.
contact.companyLine: ShopsDoor is operated by Namez AB, Sweden.
contact.formHint: Every message is read by a person on the ShopsDoor team.

footer.tagline: Build, manage, and grow your online store.
footer.operatedBy: Shops Door is operated by Namez AB, a company registered in Sweden.

door.title: What is behind the door
door.c1sub: Products, orders, pages and payments for every store you run, in one place.
door.c2sub: Open the same store to new countries with their own language, prices and domain.
door.c3sub: Start on a free ShopsDoor address and move to your own domain whenever you like.

consent.title: Em cookie bi kar tînin
consent.bodyAnalyticsMarketing: Em cookie yên pêwîst bi kar tînin da ku firoşgeh bixebite. Heke hûn razî bin, em her wiha ji bo analîz û bazarkirinê cookie û teknolojiyên wekhev bi kar tînin, û naveroka karûbarên derve yên wek YouTube û Google Maps nîşan didin. Hûn dikarin her dem hilbijartina xwe li binê rûpelê di Mîhengên cookie de biguherînin.
consent.bodyAnalytics: Em cookie yên pêwîst bi kar tînin da ku firoşgeh bixebite. Heke hûn razî bin, em her wiha ji bo analîzê cookie û teknolojiyên wekhev bi kar tînin, û naveroka karûbarên derve yên wek YouTube û Google Maps nîşan didin. Hûn dikarin her dem hilbijartina xwe li binê rûpelê di Mîhengên cookie de biguherînin.
consent.bodyMarketing: Em cookie yên pêwîst bi kar tînin da ku firoşgeh bixebite. Heke hûn razî bin, em her wiha ji bo bazarkirinê cookie û teknolojiyên wekhev bi kar tînin, û naveroka karûbarên derve yên wek YouTube û Google Maps nîşan didin. Hûn dikarin her dem hilbijartina xwe li binê rûpelê di Mîhengên cookie de biguherînin.
consent.recordings: Analîz her wiha nexşeyên germahiyê û tomarên serdanan bi rêya Microsoft Clarity dihewîne.
consent.dialogIntro: Hilbijêrin ka em dikarin kîjan cookie û teknolojiyên wekhev bi kar bînin. Cookie yên pêwîst ji bo xebata firoşgehê hewce ne û nayên girtin. Hûn dikarin her dem hilbijartina xwe biguherînin.
consent.dialogTransfer: Dibe ku hin karûbar daneyan veguhêzin welatên derveyî YE/DEA, wek DYA. Di siyaseta me ya cookie û siyaseta nepeniyê de bêtir bixwînin.
consent.dialogUngated: Ev karûbar di vê firoşgehê de bê razîbûnê tên bikaranîn: {services}.
consent.necessaryDesc: Ji bo xebata firoşgehê hewce ne, wek selik, têketin, hilbijartina ziman, dayîna ewle û di bîrê de girtina hilbijartina we ya cookie.
consent.analyticsDesc: Alîkariya me dike ku em fêm bikin firoşgeh çawa tê bikaranîn, wek kîjan rûpel tên dîtin, da ku em wê baştir bikin.
consent.analyticsRecordings: Microsoft Clarity bi nexşeyên germahiyê û tomarên serdanan nîşan dide ka serdanker çawa li ser rûpelê digerin (klîk û gerandin). Her tiştê ku hûn dinivîsin tê veşartin.
consent.marketingDesc: Ji bo pîvandina reklamên me û nîşandana pêşniyarên guncav ji we re li ser malperên din û medyaya civakî tê bikaranîn. Wê demê dane bi platformên reklamê re tên parvekirin.
consent.externalDesc: Naveroka karûbarên din rasterast li ser rûpelê nîşan dide, wek vîdyoyên ji YouTube û Vimeo û nexşeyên ji Google Maps, li cihê ku rûpelên firoşgehê wan bi kar tînin. Barkirina naverokê navnîşana IP ya we dide wî karûbarî û dibe ku cookie danîne.

company.title: Kî li pişt ShopsDoor e.
company.lead: ShopsDoor marka û platformek e ku ji aliyê Namez AB ve tê birêvebirin, şirketeke sînordar a ku li Swêdê hatiye tomarkirin.
company.roleText: Namez AB xwedî û birêvebera platforma ShopsDoor e, bi firoşkaran re Mercên karûbarê îmze dike û daneyên kesane li gorî Siyaseta nepeniyê pêvajo dike. Dayîn ji aliyê Stripe ve tên pêvajokirin; her firoşkar pereyên xwe li hesabê xwe yê Stripe werdigire.
